title: Prembly Connect Nairobi 2026 Brings Compliance and Risk Leaders Together to Discuss the Future of Compliance and Risk
summary: Prembly Connect Nairobi 2026 brought compliance, risk, legal, and onboarding leaders together to discuss the future of compliance, KYC, and fraud prevention.
body_markdown:
Prembly successfully hosted the second edition of Prembly Connect in Nairobi, Kenya, on Friday, 18 September 2026, bringing together compliance, risk, legal, and onboarding professionals from fund and asset management firms and investment banks for an evening of meaningful conversations around the future of compliance and risk.


The event provided an opportunity for industry leaders to network, exchange ideas, and explore practical approaches to strengthening KYC, onboarding, and fraud prevention processes amid an increasingly complex regulatory landscape.


Discussions also focused on the current compliance and risk landscape and how technology is shaping the way organizations manage onboarding, fraud, and regulatory risk. Attendees participated in a lively Q&A session that reflected strong interest in the practical challenges facing the sector today.


*Victor Otieno and Lorine Odhiambo of Prembly’s Kenya team host Prembly Connect Nairobi 2026.*


Hosted by Prembly’s Kenya team, Victor Otieno and Lorine Odhiambo, the event created opportunities for industry professionals to connect, share perspectives, and discuss emerging challenges while reinforcing Prembly’s commitment to supporting organizations with trusted identity infrastructure across Africa.


*Mark Muchugia, ICT Administrator at Lofty Corban, and Paul Gachara, ICT Administrator at Directline, share their firsthand experiences using Prembly’s solutions for identity verification and compliance* .


It was great to hear testimonials from industry leaders on how they have managed identity verification and their organisational compliance processes. We were also delighted to receive firsthand feedback on using our solutions from Mark Muchugia, ICT Administrator at Lofty Corban, and Paul Gachara, ICT Administrator at Directline.


Prembly Connect Nairobi 2026 reflects the company’s continued commitment to bringing together industry leaders and ecosystem stakeholders to address emerging fraud and compliance challenges, foster collaboration, and help organizations build safer, more trusted digital ecosystems.
